summary: Frontend-only landing redesign validation completed on public preview with desktop/mobile/responsive/interaction audits and non-landing regression smoke. Core immersive experience works (real Three.js rendering, mode switching, drag/reset/pause, reduced-motion behavior, WebGL fallback, FAQ/comparison usability, API-driven faculty/testimonials), but 4 high-priority landing defects were reproduced.

ui_bugs.issue: 3D scene starts too high and visually intersects hero CTA/access-note area. Measured overlap: CTA/access-note bounding boxes intersect finance-scene bounding box.

ui_bugs.component: Hero mobile controls vs help bubble
ui_bugs.issue: FAQ help bubble overlaps Reset control in hero toolbar on 390x844. Bounding boxes intersect and reduce tapability of reset.
Mobile sticky CTA bar is visible immediately on initial page load instead of only after hero scroll-out.

Mobile hero paragraph concatenates words as 'doing.Build' due hidden
with no spacing fallback.

integration_issues.issue: Console warns: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' when opening mobile Sheet.
Observed occasional console warning on landing runs: '[xp] loadLevels failed, using fallback: TypeError: Failed to fetch'.

issues: Desktop visual hierarchy is weakened because finance canvas intrudes into CTA/access region.
Mobile floating help bubble collides with scene controls near lower hero, reducing conversion/control clarity.

action_items: Raise desktop hero canvas baseline / adjust hero spacing so CTA and access note never overlap with finance scene.
Reposition mobile FAQ bubble or hero toolbar z-order/offset to prevent overlap with reset control at 390x844.

Fix mobile hero paragraph spacing when
is hidden (preserve space between sentence fragments).
Gate mobile sticky signup bar to appear only after hero is out of viewport (recheck IntersectionObserver initial state).
Add Sheet description/aria-describedby wiring to remove dialog accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceScene sets preserveDrawingBuffer=true; this enabled test frame-diff checks and confirms real rendering, but can cost performance on low-end devices—monitor if mobile jank appears.
Landing style scoping cleanup works correctly: after navigation to /courses,/course,/login,/dashboard there are no lingering .vv-immersive nodes/classes.
Comparison and FAQ include usable test ids (comparison-provider-select, compare-row-*, faq-cat-*, faq-toggle-*), enabling stable regression testing.

success_rate.frontend: ~87% (core interactions and integrations pass; 4 high-priority landing UX defects remain)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public URL only. 3D checks passed with frame fingerprint deltas and mode-specific image signatures. WebGL-disabled fallback reproduced (fallback visible, no canvas). Responsive overflow checks passed at 320/768/1024/1440. Non-landing route smoke passed and immersive styles did not leak after navigation. Exact top screenshots captured at 1920x800 and 390x844 in automation artifacts.
rca of the issue:
Root cause is layout/stacking and breakpoint CSS behavior in hero zone: (1) fixed hero height with absolute-positioned scene/toolbar allows scene to intrude into copy area on desktop; (2) mobile FAQ bubble bottom offset conflicts with hero toolbar/reset location; (3) mobile paragraph hides
via CSS without preserving whitespace, causing word concatenation; (4) sticky bar visibility logic relies on IntersectionObserver state that currently starts in visible mode on first render for mobile, likely due initial observer timing/threshold behavior.
